candidate_prospective_recipe: Query live collection using the supplied immutable event geometry bbox and candidate extent; do not insert country-name or coordinate branches in Admission code.

Choose verified cloud-free scenes that cover all candidate extent, including both entrances and intervening lakes; inspect exact scene dates, nodata, processing baseline, cloud/shadow QA, geometry quality and license.

Fetch original COG metadata and only native windows needed for the extent using HTTP Range through inherited proxy; persist original window provenance and complete source SHA when original required by policy.
Measure source grid affine/resolution/CRS/footprint and coastline-water agreement against acquired original vectors. Quantify independent accuracy and reject unknown bounds.
Downsample only if required for runtime; derivative must not claim improved native information. Record deterministic build recipe, input hashes and output grid.
Existing renderer visual remains locked; true-color imagery is a comparison/quality source unless a separate approved data-binding path can preserve the protected visual language.
No sharpen, superresolution, inferred geometry, tracing, forced admission, or lower thresholds. Only certify after actual pixels and GIS accuracy pass unchanged Admission.
